name: ipk-browser-mcp
description: IPK Groupware browser automation MCP server for Claude Code

scripts.lint:security: grep -rn 'evaluate(`' src/ && echo 'FAIL: template literal in evaluate' && exit 1 || echo 'PASS: no template literals in evaluate'
scripts.lint:imports: ! (grep -rn --include='*.ts' 'internal/primitives' src/ | grep -v '^src/internal/' | grep -v '^src/tools/') || (echo 'FAIL: src/internal/** imported from outside src/tools/**' && exit 1)
scripts.lint: npm run lint:security && npm run lint:imports && npm run lint:invariants
